bundle.shortDescription: Native PC build of your own Hyrule Warriors: Age of Imprisonment
bundle.longDescription: Age of Decomp builds your own copy of Hyrule Warriors: Age of Imprisonment (Nintendo Switch 2) into a native Windows or Linux game, with complete settings and native controller support. No game files are included.
